faq.whatQ: What is the SpeedNetRDC SIM card?
faq.whatA: A physical SIM card for phones without eSIM. It comes without a plan: you add a data plan for the countries you visit, whenever you need one.
faq.phonesQ: Which phones does it work in?
faq.phonesA: Any phone that isn't locked to a mobile operator and takes a standard SIM card.
faq.shippingQ: Where do you ship, and how long does it take?
faq.shippingA: We ship from Belgium to these countries: {countries}. Delivery takes 3–5 working days after we post it.
faq.customsQ: Are there customs fees outside the EU?
faq.customsA: Parcels to the UK, Switzerland, Norway and Iceland go through customs. Any import charges set by those countries are paid on delivery.
faq.keepQ: How long can I keep the SIM?
faq.keepA: It's yours to keep: there's no fixed end date. A SIM left unused for {period} is deactivated.
faq.dataA: Pick any plan on our site and choose “Add to my SIM”, then enter the number printed on your SIM card — or pick it from My SIMs when signed in.
faq.startA: The first time your phone connects in a country the plan covers {window}.
faq.twoQ: What if I have two plans for the same country?
faq.twoA: Plans stack: each keeps its own data and expiry. {priority}
faq.returnsQ: Can I return the SIM card?
